      Vision AI model

      Not connected. Paste the model ID and key, then press Connect.
      40%
      Where do I find these?
      • Model ID: in Roboflow open your project, then Models (or Versions). It is the project name and version number, like crop-and-weed-detection-tzihn/1. Don't use a Workflow ID.
      • API key: Settings → API Keys. The Publishable key (starts with rf_) runs the model inside this browser: fast and live. The Private key uses Roboflow's cloud instead and spends credits on every scan.
      • Class names containing weed show red, partial orange, everything else green. The key is saved only in this browser.
      Last Roboflow answer
      Nothing yet.

      Finds plants by colour. On ROBORAPTORS FARM the weeds are deep green tufts, and the crops are red and yellow flowers and pale grey-green seedlings. Quick and needs no internet, but it is a rule, not a trained AI.

      Robot & camera setup

      8 columns
      6 cm/s
      120 cm
      22 cm

      Mount the webcam on the SPIKE Prime facing straight down, with the top of the picture pointing the way the robot drives. Set the speed to match your SPIKE program, and press Start auto scan at the same moment the robot starts. Scan now checks just the current picture. With Camera motion, BIOGUARD measures how fast the ground slides past the camera, so it follows the robot even if the speed changes.

      How BIOGUARD protects the farm

      1

      Drive

      A SPIKE Prime robot drives down each bed of ROBORAPTORS FARM with a webcam looking straight down.

      2

      See

      Vision AI checks every square of the picture several times a second: crop, partial weed or weed.

      3

      Map

      Each detection lands on the farm map at the robot's position, building a heat map of where weeds grow.

      4

      Spray less

      The spray plan targets only the red hotspots, so most of the farm, its insects and its soil get no herbicide at all.
